notes.title: New Release 1.3.1
notes.notes:
Hello Power Players!

A new release today, with some small bug fixes and a new Level Guide in the community hub to help you complete the hard levels :D

Have fun!

notes.title: New Release 1.3.0
notes.notes:
Hello Power Players!

A new release today, with some small new fatures and bug fixes:

* Better UI with some tips on how to play the game
* Add a new layer to show the current level and the expected and best time to finish it
* Fixed some other small issues you didn't know they exist

Have fun playing the new version!

notes.title: New Release 1.2.0
notes.notes:
Hello Power Players!

New release today, with some new features:


 10 new levels, completing 50 levels and 100 achievements
 Now you can restore the last failed attempt and change the settings before try again
 Fixed the sound settings issue
 Fixed some other small issues you didn't know they exist


Have fun playing the new version!
